note: One row per candidate external source, with only what was actually verified. `machine_readable` is
the verdict on whether an automated client can obtain structured data, not on whether the data is
open in principle. A source with no machine-readable interface stays out of the retrieval layer
however good its licence looks, and a snapshot is never hand-transcribed into a source.

sources.title: THL national Code Service (Kansallinen koodistopalvelu)
sources.licence: SNOMED International Affiliate Member agreement for the national SNOMED CT subsets published on the Code Service. Operator decision: this system is the operating organisation's own official social- and health-care information system, which is the class the service description's free-retrieval scope names, so the code lists are used inside it
sources.licence_basis: conditional permission scoped to information systems of organisations operating in Finland, not an open-data licence; the operator affirms this system is one of them (decision recorded in this repository's reference layer). The decision covers use inside the organisation's own systems and does not grant redistribution
constraints: The interfaces are reachable only from Finland, including Ahvenanmaa; outside Finland they are reachable only for permitted source countries through nationalcodeservice.kanta.fi
Automated extraction is documented as best done through the message or Web Services interface
Content support: koodistopalvelu@thl.fi; platform support: tekninentuki@kanta.fi
sources.redistribution: not open data; do not redistribute, and do not serve a snapshot outside the organisation's own systems

sources.title: Fimea open data (medicinal products basic register, availability disruptions, interchangeable products, Lääke75+)
sources.licence_basis: national catalogue licence field `cc-by-4.0` / Creative Commons Attribution 4.0
sources.reason: the national catalogue carries one resource with no format and no download URL (a link to the human page), the catalogue's own `isopen` flag is false, and fimea.fi answers HTTP 403 to a non-browser client, so no automated structured distribution could be confirmed
constraints: Ask Fimea (ict@fimea.fi) for the machine-readable distribution before relying on this source
The operator may download a file by hand, but then it is an operator-supplied snapshot with recorded provenance, not a fetched source
sources.redistribution: CC BY 4.0 permits redistribution with attribution, once a real distribution is confirmed

sources.title: UpToDate Expert AI
sources.licence: event-scoped hackathon access (browser credentials valid 7 days from issue); production use requires a Wolters Kluwer agreement
sources.licence_basis: vendor-provided event access, not an open licence; captures are event-scoped and must not be redistributed or committed unless the terms allow it
sources.reason: the event path is manual prompting in a browser; the vendor states a production API exists but it is not available to this build, so the event path is an operator-supplied capture carrying its prompt, audience, capture time and SHA-256
constraints: Credentials pending from the vendor; valid 7 days from issue
Answers default to a physician register, so the audience must be stated in the prompt and shown on the rendered statement
UpToDate content in the product description is professional guidance, not our finding: it is attributed, dated and never paraphrased into an unsourced claim
sources.redistribution: not permitted for the event-scoped access

sources.title: Finnish national Code Service (Koodistopalvelu) — ICD-10, ATC and laboratory nomenclature
sources.licence: CodeServer käyttöoikeuslisenssi (Elisa Oyj) for the platform; THL owns the content. Operator decision: this system is the operating organisation's own official social- and health-care information system, which is the class the service description names ("haettavissa kansallisiin sosiaali- ja terveydenhuollon sähköisissä asiakirjajärjestelmiin"), so the code lists are retrieved and used inside it
sources.licence_basis: operator-affirmed scope decision recorded in this repository's reference layer. It is NOT a claim that the service is open data, and it does not grant redistribution. Anonymous GET access to the JSON REST API; THL owns the content, Kela the platform, Elisa the CodeServer product
sources.attribution: THL / Koodistopalvelu (ICD-10: THL; ATC: Fimea; laboratory nomenclature: Kuntaliitto)
constraints: Reachable only from Finland, including Ahvenanmaa; outside Finland only for permitted source countries through nationalcodeservice.kanta.fi
GET is documented as requiring no authentication; POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE require a JWT
Large classifications are officially meant to be taken as `julkaisut` publication files, but the anonymous REST API returns the same codes and needs no JSF session
FinLOINC on the Code Service is only the 156-code physiological-measurement subset, not the full LOINC release
sources.redistribution: not open data. Under that scope decision the operator may use the code lists inside the organisation's own systems, but the snapshot stays local (gitignored) and is never redistributed, mirrored or re-served. Ask koodistopalvelu@thl.fi before any publication

sources.title: Käypä hoito clinical guidelines — linking and citation only
sources.licence: Site terms of use, Finnish text dated 2.2.2026: linking to a guideline is explicitly permitted, and citation is permitted under prescribed forms; using, copying, sharing or otherwise exploiting the content to train, develop or improve any AI application is prohibited
sources.licence_basis: the terms bind the user, and the only carve-out is a minor amount for the user's own private use in an application that neither stores the data permanently nor uses it for training — a multi-user product with a database satisfies neither limb
sources.attribution: Duodecim and the Käypä hoito working groups; the site name www.kaypahoito.fi must appear in any republication
constraints: No API and no bulk download of content exists; a WordPress sitemap index at /wp-sitemap.xml is metadata only
The prescribed link form is https://www.kaypahoito.fi/hoiNNNNN, where the hoi code identifies one guideline
Citation must name the latest published version and must display www.kaypahoito.fi
The English rights page is dated 29.4.2021 and omits the AI clause entirely, so it understates the restriction; cite the Finnish text
Content must never be ingested into an index, embedded, or placed in a model prompt, regardless of commercial status
sources.redistribution: linking and citation only; content ingestion is prohibited by the 2.2.2026 AI clause
sources.reason: there is no API and no bulk download of the content, and the terms of use prohibit ingesting it into any AI system, so only linking and citation are permitted; the site root itself was read at HTTP 200 (text/html), which establishes that the guidelines are reachable, not that their content is usable

sources.title: TERO — Finnish Ontology of Health and Welfare (via Finto)
sources.publisher: National Library of Finland (Finto), maintaining the Finnish thesauri and ontologies
sources.licence_basis: verified at https://finto.fi/tero/en/ as the publisher's own statement; note it is an older CC version than CC BY 4.0
constraints: TERO is concept labels and synonyms; the search also returns YSO concepts, which are a different vocabulary with its own licence, so YSO hits are not covered by the TERO licence
TERO is general health-and-welfare terminology: useful for Finnish labels, concepts and phrasing, and it carries no clinical recommendations
Languages offered are en, fi and sv with fi as the default
sources.redistribution: CC BY 3.0 permits redistribution with attribution; concept labels and synonyms only; YSO hits require their own licence

sources.title: THL Sote-sanastot (Finnish social and healthcare vocabularies)
sources.licence_basis: verified at https://sotesanastot.thl.fi as stated on the site; the web service source code is EUPL-1.2

operations: GET /api/vocabularies — 8 vocabularies with metadata and publish dates
GET /api/vocabularies/{vocabularyId}/concepts — concepts list with preferred labels and status
GET /api/vocabularies/{vocabularyId}/concepts/{conceptId} — concept details with synonyms, definitions, notes and status

constraints: These are information-management concepts (terms, synonyms, definitions, status), NOT clinical codes, and no guideline content is stored
Concepts are in the 'concept' namespace; they do not label ATC, ICD-10, measure or instrument codes
sources.redistribution: CC BY 4.0 permits redistribution with attribution; terms, definitions and status only; no clinical guideline text is stored

sources.title: FHIR FI Base Profiles — Finnish security and visibility code systems
constraints: Labels are display-only: do not wire them into any policy, permission or visibility decision
No profiles are vendored — only the code systems' labels for security and visibility
sources.redistribution: CC0-1.0 dedication — public domain dedication, no restrictions

sources.title: YTI Interoperability Platform (Yhteentoimivuusalusta) — code registries
sources.licence: per item — CC0 or CC BY 4.0, chosen by the publisher (DVV terms 10.1.2020 §8: "lähtökohtaisesti CC0 tai CC BY 4.0 -lisensseillä"; CC BY-ND 4.0 also observed on sanastot.suomi.fi)
sources.licence_basis: per-item licensing under DVV Yhteentoimivuusalustan käyttöehdot sisällöntuottajaorganisaatioille (10.1.2020 §8); each item carries its own licence. The API specification is licensed under EUPL-1.2 separately from the content
sources.api_specification_licence: EUPL-1.2 (upstream OpenAPI documents declare license: EUPL-1.2, with termsOfService pointing to EUPL-1.1)
sources.attribution: Digi- ja väestötietovirasto (DVV) and the publishing organizations
constraints: sotute holds one legislative scheme (saadostyyppi / Statute type classification), not clinical code lists
The content licence is per item (CC0, CC BY 4.0, or CC BY-ND 4.0) chosen by the publishing organization, not a uniform platform licence

API specification is licensed under EUPL-1.2 (with termsOfService noting EUPL-1.1); consuming the HTTP API does not copyleft downstream code, but client libraries or OpenAPI spec files carry copyleft obligations if vendored
Public GET API requires no authentication
sources.redistribution: per item: depends on the item's individual licence (CC0 or CC BY 4.0 permit redistribution with attribution; CC BY-ND 4.0 restricts derivative works). API specification is EUPL-1.2

sources.title: THL Määräys 5/2024 (olennaiset vaatimukset) and its annexes — Liite 2 requirement list, profiles 3a–3h, Liite 4 system form
sources.licence: THL's site terms assert copyright by default — "Thl.fi-verkkopalvelussa olevan aineiston tekijänoikeudet kuuluvat THL:lle, ellei toisin mainita" (https://thl.fi/tietoa-sivustosta, updated 13.7.2026) — while permitting text quotation with attribution and linking. Whether the detached .xlsx annexes are part of the regulation exempt under Tekijänoikeuslaki 404/1961 9 § 1 mom 2 k, or independent works protected under 9 § 2 mom, is an OPEN question of law. The annexes ARE bound to the regulation by its own text: "Tämän määräyksen liitteenä olevat profiilit ovat velvoittavia…" (Määräys 5/2024 § 7)
sources.licence_basis: Owner work-around decision recorded in this repository's reference layer §4: during the demo window, cite and quote-with-source; do not vendor; parse a workbook only at runtime into a gitignored area. This is an owner decision, NOT a legal finding, and it does not settle the §9 2 mom question
sources.attribution: THL — Sosiaali- ja terveydenhuollon järjestelmien ja hyvinvointisovellusten olennaiset vaatimukset (Määräys 5/2024)

operations: GET Liite 2 Olennaisten vaatimusten luettelo (xlsx, v403 22.6.2026, 554 254 bytes)
GET Määräys 4/2024 luokittelu ja sertifiointi (pdf, 578 234 bytes)

constraints: Owner work-around is time-scoped to the demo window and is not a licence: it permits citing, short quotation with the source cited, and runtime parsing
Requirement identifiers, verified URLs and short quoted requirement texts may be pinned; the workbook itself is never committed
If the full matrix is needed at runtime, fetch it into a gitignored temporary area and discard it afterwards
Redistribution of the annex files is not permitted under the work-around; the underlying licence question remains open (ask sotetiedonhallinta@thl.fi or obtain a legal read)
sources.redistribution: not permitted as a workbook. Cite, quote short requirement texts with attribution, or parse at runtime into a gitignored area; never vendor or re-serve the annex files

sources.title: Sosmeta — sosiaalihuollon asiakirjarakenteiden ja metatietojen palvelu (data components and document definitions)
sources.licence: no content licence is stated on the service; the pages link only to a privacy statement, an accessibility statement and visitor tracking
sources.licence_basis: verified by direct fetch of https://sosmeta.thl.fi/data-components and a component page state no licence, so thl.fi's site-wide copyright claim applies by default — the service does not 'state otherwise' in the sense of that clause
sources.reason: server-rendered HTML with per-component Excel downloads, a schema download and an Atom change feed; it exposes no documented API and states no licence, so no automated distribution may be treated as licensed
constraints: Host trap: sosmeta.fi answers HTTP 200 while serving a PHP/MySQL fatal error; the live host is sosmeta.thl.fi
Cite deep links (/data-components/{uuid}, /document-definitions/list) or record identifiers and dates; do not vendor schemas, field definitions or component lists
A document definition can be downloaded as a schema or as an all-public-schemas archive, but under an unstated licence it stays a citation
The Atom change feed at /rss/changes is usable as a change signal; versions are date strings such as 2026-09-11 and 2026-08-26R02
sources.redistribution: not permitted: licence not stated. Cite by URL and pin identifiers and dates only
